words.gloss: of whatever greatness it may be

literal: Of whatever greatness having become even in the case of, excellence of action in those who lack, non-existent is the fortress.
translation: Even if a fortress possesses every kind of greatness, it is as good as non-existent for those who lack excellence in action.
modern: எவ்வளவு பெருமைகளைக் கொண்டதாக ஒரு கோட்டை இருந்தாலும், செயலில் சிறந்த திறமை இல்லாதவர்களிடம் அது இல்லாததற்குச் சமம் ஆகும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes that physical defenses are only as good as the people who man them. A fortress may have every imaginable greatness, such as high walls, deep moats, and ample resources. However, if the defenders lack excellence of action, the fort becomes completely useless. Ultimately, the true strength of a defense lies in the skill and bravery of its defenders, not just its physical structure.
